title: Asian-Crusted Chicken
description: Chicken breasts spread with a mayonnaise, green onion, soy and ginger topping and baked under a crisp crumb crust.

ingredients.note: finely grated — or ¼ tsp ground ginger

steps.heading: Mix the Topping
steps.text: Combine the mayonnaise, green onion, soy sauce and ginger in a medium bowl.

steps.heading: Coat
steps.text: Arrange the chicken on a baking sheet. Spread the mayonnaise mixture evenly over the tops, then sprinkle with the bread crumbs (and sesame seeds, if using).

steps.heading: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.

notes: For an extra layer of flavor, stir 1 tbsp sesame seeds into the bread crumbs before sprinkling them over the chicken.
